contract_tests.exact_meaning: Universal Source Registry instantiation and source qualification verification
Manifest verification and cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint checking
Verification that canonical Surahs count equals exactly 114
Verification that canonical numbered Ayahs count equals exactly 6236
Verification that standalone unnumbered opening Basmalas count equals exactly 112
Verification that total Quran records (6236 verses + 112 opening Basmalas) equals exactly 6348
Verification that duplicate composite keys (Surah:Ayah:Type) equal exactly 0
Verification that missing canonical Ayahs across all 114 Surahs equal exactly 0
Verification that English and translation linkage points correctly to canonical Ayah records
Verification that morphological token segments link directly to canonical Ayahs and roots
Verification that provenance chains resolve back to raw source byte offsets and records
Verification of human-authorized canonical reconciliations for Surah 27:0 duplicate and Surahs 95:1 / 97:1 Basmalas
Verification of round-trip text reconstruction fidelity and diacritical byte-for-byte exactness
Verification of Source Vault immutability, discovery, and read-only protection
Verification that all governance and data changes are cataloged with complete cryptographic signatures
Verification that Phase 0 operates strictly in shadow mode with zero active runtime database mutation
